from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalanceEntry(BaseModel):
    """A specific cash balance value found within a financial document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name associated with this financial statement")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The label used in the financial statement (e.g., 'Cash and cash equivalents')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the balance reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    timing: str | None = Field(description="Whether this is a beginning, ending, or other balance (e.g., 'beginning balance')")
    period_date: str | None = Field(description="The specific date or period the balance refers to (e.g., 'December 31, 2023')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short verbatim text anchoring the extracted value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balances: list[CashBalanceEntry]
